_doc: Fidelity-risk ACKNOWLEDGED carve-out (item R1, landed 2026-07-18). The fidelityRisk gate (FidelityRiskGateTest) fails LOUDLY, per combo, whenever a pinned Green/Amber combo rests on a card whose gold fixture is on tests/magic-ast-tests/Fixtures/oracle-text-quarantine.json (known-drifted oracle text) -- GoldCorpus reads Output.Oracle.Abilities directly and never re-parses Input.OracleText, so a drifted fixture silently props up whatever tier its combos certify at. This whitelist is the SAME shrink-only-ratchet pattern as oracle-text-quarantine.json itself: an entry here says 'yes, this pin currently rests on already-tracked quarantine debt, and that is KNOWN and accepted for now' -- NOT that the pin is correct. Matching is on (id, fixture) PAIRS, not id alone: each entry's 'fixtures' array names exactly which quarantined fixtures are acknowledged for that combo, so a DIFFERENT/NEW quarantine hit on an already-acknowledged combo (e.g. a second card in the same combo getting quarantined later) is NOT silently swallowed -- it fails as its own, separate, unacknowledged risk. An acknowledged fixture that's no longer at risk (de-quarantined/fixed) FAILS until removed from 'fixtures' -- the list only shrinks, per-fixture, same as the quarantine it mirrors. DATA AUDIT (interaction-review, 2026-07-18): every entry below was independently re-verified against authoritative oracle text and the engine's actual reasoning for its combo (via --explain edge trails). None masks a live tier error -- all drift is either cosmetic (reminder-text wording) or a strictly-conservative/irrelevant subset that cannot over-certify the pinned tier. Three fixtures (RIX/PitilessPlunderer, ELD/CorridorMonitor, PLC/EssenceWarden) carry genuine (non-tier-affecting) mechanical drift and are separately flagged as ordinary gold-fidelity debt worth a GoldRegenerationUtility re-point, not urgent.
